summary: New FollowThroughRecord entity, kept fully independent of FINTRACK-21's compute-on-read GetWeeklyRecommendationHandler (untouched) -- resolves BA's open architecture question by following FINTRACK-22's Alert write-time-persistence precedent rather than inventing something new. Keyed by (user_id, period_start), created idempotently by the presentation layer on GET /recommendations/weekly. AC4's 7-day auto-ignore enforced via read-time reconciliation, no new job runner. Every follow-through endpoint scoped by user_id (IDOR-safe, 404 not 403); invalid action values rejected before any record lookup (400, no state change). Migration 0008 adds one new table, no changes to any existing table. PR #32 opened, real CI green (Test Suite + Security Scan). Full local regression (280 unit + 127 integration + 122 security) unchanged.
